states.name: Size-selected amplified Feature Barcode DNA (~129 bp)
properties: carried forward in the 0.6X SPRIselect supernatant
TSO-derived sequence is lost because the reverse primer anneals inside Read 2

transitions.operation_detail: GEM-RT incubation: MMLV-type reverse transcriptase extends the poly(dT) gel-bead primer on captured mRNA and, through its DNA-dependent DNA polymerase activity, extends the Capture Sequence 1 gel-bead primer on the antibody-derived DNA oligo; terminal transferase activity adds untemplated cytosines to the 3' ends. GEM breakage and silane cleanup are folded into this transition.

Terminal transferase activity of the reverse transcriptase adds untemplated cytosines on reaching the 5' end of the mRNA template, and the TSO anneals through its riboguanosines and is copied. Template switching occurs only on the mRNA branch; the antibody-derived product is copied from a DNA template and terminates at TruSeq Read 2.
Pooled amplification with Feature cDNA Primers 2 (PN-2000097), a mixture of the mRNA and Feature Barcode primer pairs, produces the long gene-expression cDNA and ~129 bp Feature Barcode DNA together.

major_reagents.name: SPRIselect reagent
major_reagents.role: size separation into bead-bound and supernatant fractions

transitions.operation_detail: A 0.6X SPRIselect separation retains long gene-expression cDNA on the beads and carries the ~129 bp Feature Barcode product in the supernatant; the two fractions then enter their library-specific branches.
Enzymatic fragmentation, end repair and A-tailing of the amplified cDNA (CG000185 Step 3.1), with double-sided SPRIselect size selection folded in.
Ligation of the PN-2000094 partial Read 2 adaptor (5'-GATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA-3' / 3'-TCTAGCCTTCTCG-5') to the A-tailed end (CG000185 Step 3.3); post-ligation cleanup folded in.

Sample Index PCR with the P5/partial Read 1 primer PN-2000095 (5'-AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCT-ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTC-3') and the Chromium i7 Sample Index primer PN-220103 (CG000185 Step 3.5), adding P5, the 8-nt sample index and P7; SPRIselect cleanup and QC folded in.

Cell Surface Protein library construction: sample index PCR with Feature SI Primers 2 (PN-2000099) and the Chromium i7 Sample Index primer (PN-220103); post-PCR SPRIselect size selection, QC and quantification are folded into this transition.
